back_translation: Concerning Moab, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Woe to Nebo, for it has been devastated; Kiriathaim is captured and disgraced; the fortress is shattered and dismantled.
There is no more praise for Moab; in Heshbon they plotted evil against her: Come, let us cut her off from being a nation. You too, O Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
A voice of crying from Horonaim: devastation and great destruction!
Moab is shattered; her little ones cry out.
For on the ascent of Luhith they go up weeping bitterly; for on the descent of Horonaim the foes have heard a cry of distress over the destruction.
Flee! Save your lives! Become like a shrub in the desert.
Because you trust in your works and your treasures, you too will be captured; and Chemosh will go into exile, his priests and his officials together.
The destroyer will come against every city, and no city will escape; the valley will perish and the high plain be destroyed, as the LORD has said.
Give wings to Moab, for she must fly away; her cities will become a desolation, with no one to dwell in them.
Cursed is the one who does the work of the LORD negligently, and cursed is the one who withholds his sword from blood.
Moab has been at ease from his youth, settled on his dregs; he has not been poured from vessel to vessel, nor gone into exile. So his flavor has remained in him, and his aroma is unchanged.
Therefore behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will send to him those who pour, and they will pour him out; they will empty his vessels and shatter his jars.
Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their trust.
How can you say, We are warriors, men of valor for battle?
Moab is destroyed and its towns invaded; the choicest of its young men have gone down to the slaughter, declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts.
Moab's calamity is near at hand, and his affliction hastens very swiftly.
Mourn for him, all you around him, and all who know his name; say, How the mighty scepter is broken, the glorious staff!
Come down from glory and sit on parched ground, O daughter dwelling in Dibon, for the destroyer of Moab has come against you; he has destroyed your fortresses.
Stand by the road and watch, O dweller of Aroer; ask the man who flees and the woman who escapes, What has happened?
Moab is put to shame, for it is shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
Judgment has come upon the high plain—upon Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath,
upon Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,
upon Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,
upon Kerioth, Bozrah, and all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.
The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, declares the LORD.
Make him drunk, because he magnified himself against the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he too will become a laughingstock.
Was not Israel a laughingstock to you? Was he found among thieves, that whenever you speak of him you shake your head?
Abandon the towns and settle among the rocks, O dwellers of Moab; be like a dove that nests at the mouth of a chasm.
We have heard of the pride of Moab—exceedingly proud—his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.
I know his insolence, declares the LORD, but it is futile; his boasting has accomplished nothing.
Therefore I will wail for Moab; I will cry out for all of Moab; I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for you more than for Jazer; your tendrils crossed the sea, reaching as far as the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen upon your summer fruit and your vintage.
Joy and gladness are taken away from the orchard and from the land of Moab; I have made the wine cease from the presses; no one treads with shouting—the shouting is not for joy.
From the cry of Heshbon to Elealeh, as far as Jahaz they raise their voices, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim have become desolate.
And I will bring an end in Moab, declares the LORD, to the one who offers on the high place and burns incense to his gods.
Therefore my heart moans for Moab like flutes, and my heart moans like flutes for the men of Kir-heres, because the wealth they gained has perished.
For every head is shaved and every beard clipped; on every hand are gashes, and on every waist is sackcloth.
On all the rooftops of Moab and in its squares there is nothing but mourning, for I have shattered Moab like a vessel no one wants, declares the LORD.
How shattered it is! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! So Moab has become a laughingstock and a horror to all around him.
For this is what the LORD says: Behold, the enemy swoops down like an eagle and spreads his wings over Moab.
Kerioth is captured and the strongholds are seized; and in that day the heart of Moab's warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he magnified himself against the LORD.
Terror and pit and snare are upon you, O dweller of Moab, declares the LORD.
Whoever flees from the terror will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in the snare; for I will bring upon Moab the year of their punishment, declares the LORD.

The refugees stand helpless in the shadow of Heshbon, for fire has gone out from Heshbon and a flame from within Sihon; it has devoured the forehead of Moab and the crown of the head of the sons of tumult.
Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished, for your sons have been taken into captivity and your daughters into exile.
Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in the latter days, declares the LORD. Thus far is the judgment on Moab.
